milestones.title: M4.1 Contracts and compatibility
acceptance_criteria: Versioned stream, event, incident and metric contracts validate from fixtures
Compatibility policy describes unknown fields and schema versions

milestones.title: M4.2 Stream adapter and provider normalizers
acceptance_criteria: M3 continues draining both streams when the M4 queue fills
Provider fixtures normalize supported fields and preserve unsupported states

milestones.title: M4.3 Activity and incidents
acceptance_criteria: Activity views correlate process identity and expose uncertainty
Every detector has a deterministic trigger, dedupe key and resolution rule

milestones.title: M4.4 Durable history and queries
acceptance_criteria: Restart replay is idempotent and outbox retries are durable
Retention, query and resource-pressure behavior are bounded and visible

milestones.title: M4.5 M1/M2 integration
acceptance_criteria: M1 records incident references without changing task or attempt state
M2 reads only provenance-aware metrics and does not compare incompatible values

milestones.title: M4.6 Operations and adversarial verification
acceptance_criteria: SSH operations and compatibility limits are documented
Offline matrix and measured three-agent baseline meet approved limits

tasks.title: Define versioned stream, normalized-event, incident and metric contracts
tasks.objective: Specify versioned shapes and compatibility rules for the M4 data boundaries.
tasks.estimate_rationale: M4 boundaries are new, but M1 event shapes and all required fields are already inventoried.

complexity.justification: Several schemas need consistent identity, clocks, allowlists and evolution rules

scope.justification: The task defines contracts and fixtures without adding monitor runtime behavior

duration.justification: Schema drafting and focused fixtures fit one bounded contract session

risk.justification: A weak version boundary could corrupt correlation or preserve sensitive data

coupling.justification: The stream contract is consumed next by the M3 adapter task

confidence.justification: Existing M1 contracts and the requested fields have been inspected

acceptance_criteria: Stream, event, incident and metric schemas validate versions
Missing identities and timestamps remain explicit unknowns
Unknown provider schemas do not create fabricated fields

verification.value: cd skill/scripts && python3 -m unittest discover -s bt_scheduler_monitor/tests -p 'test_contracts.py' -v
verification.purpose: validate M4 boundary contracts and fixtures

tasks.title: Add bounded nonblocking M3 stdout/stderr stream frames
tasks.objective: Expose independently drained stdout and stderr frames through a bounded M3 stream port.
tasks.estimate_rationale: The shim currently merges streams; exact queue tuning still depends on implementation measurements.

complexity.justification: Separating current pipes while preserving artifact behavior touches the supervisor boundary

scope.justification: The change spans the M3 shim and the M4 stream handoff contract

duration.justification: Pipe separation and overflow tests require a focused integration session

risk.justification: Stream frame blocking or mislabeling could stall agents or corrupt parsing.

coupling.justification: The stream adapter must implement T1 contracts and preserve M3 pipe ownership

confidence.justification: The current merged output and bounded shim behavior were inspected

acceptance_criteria: Stdout and stderr keep independent sequence and byte offsets
Queue saturation produces gaps while both pipes continue draining
Existing output artifact size limits continue to hold

verification.value: cd skill/scripts && python3 -m unittest discover -s bt_scheduler_executor/tests -p 'test_shim.py' -v && python3 -m unittest discover -s bt_scheduler_executor/tests -p 'test_stream.py' -v && python3 -m unittest discover -s bt_scheduler_monitor/tests -p 'test_stream.py' -v
verification.purpose: verify detached stream framing, nonblocking delivery and explicit gaps

tasks.title: Normalize Claude, Codex and Antigravity JSONL with Gemini fixture-only support
tasks.objective: Normalize supported provider JSONL into allowlisted M4 events with fixture coverage.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Claude and Antigravity conventions are known, while Codex and Gemini event fixtures remain new.

complexity.justification: Three launchable providers have distinct event vocabularies and usage fields

scope.justification: The task adds per-provider normalizers plus a fixture-only Gemini parser

duration.justification: Four fixture adapters and compatibility cases need one substantial session

risk.justification: Provider payloads can contain private text and schema changes can mislead M2

coupling.justification: Every provider parser consumes the T2 frame and T1 envelope contracts

confidence.justification: Claude fixtures exist while Codex JSONL and Gemini remain documentation-derived

acceptance_criteria: Claude Codex and Antigravity fixtures normalize allowlisted fields
Gemini fixtures never advertise an M3 launch route
Unknown source event shapes remain visible as unsupported

tasks.title: Apply field allowlists and bounded redaction before persistence
tasks.objective: Remove unrestricted provider content before any normalized data reaches M4 storage.
tasks.estimate_rationale: The allowlist is narrow, but fail-closed redaction behavior requires adversarial fixtures.

complexity.justification: Redaction and allowlisting must fail closed across nested untrusted provider objects

scope.justification: The task owns one privacy boundary between parsers and persistence

duration.justification: Field allowlists and injected redaction failures fit a focused security session

risk.justification: A redaction miss could persist secrets code or private project text

coupling.justification: The persistence boundary consumes provider output produced by T3

confidence.justification: The redaction boundary can reuse existing provider telemetry fixtures.

acceptance_criteria: Raw provider values are absent from persisted query results
Redaction failure withholds excerpts instead of saving text
Evidence digests and excerpts obey their size limits

verification.value: cd skill/scripts && python3 -m unittest discover -s bt_scheduler_monitor/tests -p 'test_redaction.py' -v

tasks.title: Build per-attempt activity state with process identity corroboration
tasks.objective: Project correlated activity and process identity without treating silence as death.
tasks.estimate_rationale: The output envelope is defined, but activity reconciliation edge behavior is new.

complexity.justification: Activity needs separate source clocks process state and stream integrity

scope.justification: The task adds an activity projection and read-only process identity checks

duration.justification: Per-attempt state and identity edge cases need a dedicated modeling session

risk.justification: False process death could mislead operators and future recovery decisions

coupling.justification: Activity joins normalized events with M3 identity observations and T3 output

confidence.justification: M3 shim identity ownership and event fields are visible in the checkout

acceptance_criteria: Activity separates source time receipt time and process status
PID reuse never joins two execution identities
Quiet live processes remain informational and nonblocking
